classification: Post-event development experiment with additional exploratory retrospective analysis; separate future panel
primary_hypothesis: Training ordered continuous quantile heads with dollar pinball loss improves seven-day development loss relative to the same head interface at update zero; later market accuracy requires prospective evaluation

model.optimizer: Fresh Adam on weight-only warm start; original optimizer moments not reused

data.reuse: Unchanged v19 314 training windows / 942 horizon examples, development 16 seven-day cases on two reused dates; same historical provenance limitations

objective.name: Sorted continuous-head quantile pinball
objective.encoding: Each tau-specific answer-token softmax over frozen 19 price levels encodes a scalar weighted mean, not a predictive probability distribution. Sort the three means before both training loss and evaluation.
objective.loss: Mean dollar pinball across three ordered quantiles and horizon groups, divided by one global positive median training anchor; scaling does not alter relative cell weights
objective.crossing: Sort three scalar heads with differentiable torch.sort; retain raw crossing frequency
objective.label: One matured realized price per horizon is valid supervision for asymmetric quantile regression; no claim of observed quantile labels
objective.comparison_caution: Compared with parent categorical forecasts, representation and objective both change. Only head-zero versus trained isolates updates within this interface.

fixed_ensembles: Uniform three-seed probability pool then registered quantiles
controls.selection: Choose the lower development seven-day ensemble score; exact ties choose quantile average. Freeze before computing additional retrospective ensemble scores.
controls.label: Ensemble gains are postprocessing, not new weight learning

selection.rule: Lowest development seven-day pinball, update zero eligible, earliest update exact tie
selection.expansion_gate: Pilot selected update >0; development pinball at least 2% lower than BOTH head-zero and unchanged v19 price/17 parent; zero development fallbacks. Threshold is an engineering gate, not statistical evidence.
selection.expansion: If gate passes, same objective/budget with seeds29/43, warm-start corresponding frozen price parent. Otherwise stop initial campaign and publish result. No automatic hyperparameter search.
selection.retrospective: Only selected checkpoint evaluated after selection is saved; no change to original studies or selections

implementation.loss_api: Existing supported client-side forward_backward_custom callback; no alpha API

sources.adopt: Distinguish quantile averaging from probability pooling
Ordered quantile rearrangement; no novelty claim

limitations: Opened development and retrospective dates cannot establish future improvement
Warm start already selected on same development period
Support bounded to frozen v19 extent; report out-of-support labels
No news/BLS/availability feature attribution in this price-only study
